TRIGGERED_ABILITY.TRIGGER: return TriggerObject():GetCardType():Test( CARD_TYPE_CREATURE ) and TriggerObject() ~= EffectSource()
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.CONTINUOUS_ACTION: if TriggerObject() ~= nil then local characteristics = TriggerObject():GetCurrentCharacteristics() characteristics:Power_Add( 2 ) characteristics:Toughness_Add( 0 ) end
if TriggerObject() ~= nil then local characteristics = TriggerObject():GetCurrentCharacteristics() characteristics:Bool_Set( CHARACTERISTIC_HASTE, 1 ) end
